LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingDesc: By long-standing custom, the vivi federation has begun sending old fairy tale books to the new nest that resonates with an everflower.\n\nWhether you will witness the everflower come into full bloom as in legends of old depends on you.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageTales: When you perform the everflower attunement ritual while the everflower is sufficiently attuned, the vivi federation senses the wave and sends one volume of a fairy tale book.\n\nBooks received: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageInquiry: All the old fairy tale books have arrived. Contact the vivi federation via comms console to ask about the custom surrounding the fairy tale books and the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageResonance: The vivi federation did not know the original reason behind the custom either, but they shared an old legend of a far larger everflower that once existed long ago.\n\nContinuing to resonate through everflower rituals may eventually let you sense something hidden. Perhaps there is a clue in the fairy tale books...
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageRuins: Travel to the location believed to hold the ancient ruins. If a royal vivi resonating with a great everflower visits the site, they may be able to discover something.\n\n???: {1} / {2}
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageRuinsExtract: Extract the vivi archotech core from the central altar.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageAltar: Build an everflower altar with the vivi archotech core, enshrine the everflower, and perform the full bloom ritual.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageAltarCoreLost: If both the vivi archotech core and the altar are lost, you can contact the vivi federation via comms console to request recovery of the lost core.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageBloom: The everflower is condensing mana for its final bloom.\n\nDefend the altar until it is ready, then have the resonator perform the coronation. If the altar, everflower, or resonator is lost, the bloom is interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStageHostile: Progress has stopped because you are hostile to the vivi federation. Once relations recover, it will resume where it left off.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStepEnshrine: Enshrine an everflower of attunement level {0} at the center of the altar
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingStepParticipants: Vivis to attend the full bloom ritual (excluding resonator): {0} / {1}
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingTruthLog: Left alone beneath the burning flower's shade, the old empress Asphodel opened her circuits beyond their limit so as not to lose a single one of the children she had borne, and took the countless vivis beneath the shade into herself as little lights. But one soul could not bear that weight. Her attunement and her self collapsed, and the shade was left empty.\n\nThe little lights remembered her last kindness. They did not leave the twisted empress, staying by her side and wrapping around her through the long ages. Even after her monstrous shell fell, they gathered once more to shield her—until at last the bond came undone, the empress fell asleep, and the freed lights returned to rest within the everflower on the altar, waiting for the spring when they will wake again.
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale1_Title: Flowershade Tales I: The Spring That Never Wilted
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale1_Desc: Long, long ago, in the middle of a frozen field, a great golden flower bloomed all alone. Beneath the warm shade of its petals, countless nests gathered and made a little world of their own.\n\nThey were born with fragile wings, yet beneath the flower's shade no one ever learned how to wither. Forgetting whether cold winds blew outside, they all lived leaning on a spring that seemed as if it would last forever.
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale2_Title: Flowershade Tales II: Mother of All Nests
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale2_Desc: High upon a dais at the heart of the flower's shade lived a gentle soul who wore a radiant crown. She watched over every nest, great and small, with tender eyes, and everyone followed her, calling her the mother of all nests.\n\nBy day she came down from the dais to stroke the fragile wings, and by night she stayed alone upon it, gazing out at the dark horizon beyond the nest. Thanks to the mother keeping watch all through the night, the children could fall fast asleep without a single worry.
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale3_Title: Flowershade Tales III: The Queen and the Little Lights
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale3_Desc: Whenever the queen walked beneath the flower's shade, little lights like fireflies always circled around her. Watching that soft glow, the young wings felt at ease, as though they had met a gentle friend.\n\nFrom a certain year, a chill crept into the edges of the shade and the golden petals began to tremble faintly. Standing with the little lights, the queen shielded them from the wind with her slender shoulders and guarded the trembling nest with the same warm smile as ever.
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale4_Title: Flowershade Tales IV: A Dream Happy Forever
LanguageData.VV_FairyTale4_Desc: At last, on the day a fierce darkness from outside fell upon the flower's shade, the kind queen turned all the children beneath it into little lights, so that not a single one would be hurt.\n\nThe queen had taken in so many lights that she grew terribly weary, and the little lights wrapped her up warmly, carried her far away, and tucked her in to sleep. In a warm dream where no cold wind could reach, the queen and the children never parted again and lived happily ever after.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale1: By long-standing custom, the vivi federation has sent the first volume of an old fairy tale book to the new nest that completed its attunement ritual. It tells of a great flower's shade, long ago, where no one knew how to wither.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale2: By custom, the vivi federation has sent the second volume of the old fairy tale book. It remembers a crowned ruler beneath the flower's shade, called the mother of all nests.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale3: The vivi federation has sent the third volume of the old fairy tale book. It shows the old queen, attended by little lights, guarding the trembling flower's shade.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale4: The vivi federation has sent the last volume of the old fairy tale book. It tells how, on the day darkness fell, the queen took the children beneath the shade into her arms as little lights, went far away, and lived happily ever after.\n\nThe everflower appears to have stopped growing any further, yet the fairy tales describe a far larger everflower once existing. To find a way forward, you can contact the federation and ask since when, and why, they have been sending these fairy tale books.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingRuinsDetected: The moment {PAWN_labelShort} resonated with the everflower, a brief wave of pure and powerful mana was felt from a nearby region.\n\n{PAWN_labelShort} quickly marked the location on the map, though the area is normally known to hold nothing at all. Still, a royal vivi in deep resonance with an everflower might be able to uncover something hidden there.
LanguageData.VV_Comms_TraditionInquiry: Ask about the custom of the fairy tale books and everflower
LanguageData.VV_Comms_TraditionInquiryResult: {LEADER}: "Giving an everflower seed to a new nest and sending old fairy tale books as its attunement deepens is simply a tradition handed down from long ago. We do not know any deeper meaning behind it.\n\nAll that survives is an old legend saying that in the distant past, an everflower far larger than any today once bloomed."
LanguageData.VV_Comms_TaleRepurchase: Request an old fairy tale book again
LanguageData.VV_Comms_TaleRepurchaseIntro: {LEADER}: "Which volume should we send again? The cost rises a little each time we bind a book anew."
LanguageData.VV_Comms_ReplacementCoreResult: A replacement core has been restored from the circuit data secured during the first extraction.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho5:
As mana waves spread from the everflower, static entered {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits. This time it was no memory.

The whispers of countless voices and the sound of twisting bones. Something was approaching along the flow of mana.

"...Longed for... so warm..."
"...Back... to that flower's shade..."

The connection broke.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiege: As the altar's mana circuits awaken, the everflower has entered its fifth bloom. It begins condensing the mana needed for its final bloom, and the resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage V.\n\nBut drawn by the mana waves spreading far from the altar, outlanders and swarms of titanic hornets are converging on the colony. Defend the altar and the assimilating resonator until the condensation is complete.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederation: Sensing the waves of the bloom, the vivi federation has formed an alliance with you. When enemies attack, the federation will send reinforcements to fight alongside you.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederationSupport: Sensing the waves of the bloom, the vivi federation has pledged its support. When enemies attack, the federation will send reinforcements to fight alongside you.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationAid: The vivi federation has sent warriors to protect the flower's shade as it blooms again. They will fight alongside you for a time before returning home.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCalm:
Just as the everflower neared full bloom and a golden pollen mist settled over the colony, a strange psychic wave stopped its petals. The approaching enemies fell back from the ominous presence, and silence settled over the colony.

Beyond the resonance, {PAWN_labelShort} felt countless little lights flickering. Beside the approaching shadow, one little light called a name in a trembling voice.

"...Asphodel... you can stop now..."
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingApocrypha:
Dark energy gathers above the everflower, and Asphodel, the old empress from the memories in the ruins, has appeared in the twisted form of a giant hornet queen. Swarms of titanic hornets drawn by corrupted mana follow behind her.

"...If only I had this shade... the crying... my children..."

Ancient eltex needles are lodged deep in her tough carapace. Perhaps you can make use of them.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCoronation:
Following the golden petals of Asphodel's fading form, the little lights that stayed by her side to the end quietly flowed into {PAWN_labelShort}, who is assimilating with the everflower on the altar.

The long sleeplessness has finally ended, and the stilled everflower begins to pulse again.

You can now perform {PAWN_labelShort}'s coronation at the altar to complete the final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingVictoryContinue: You can continue playing in this colony. The resonator's everflower resonance reaches stage VI, removing the fatigue and movement penalties from the fairy bond, and adult vivis in the colony age much more slowly.\n\nYou can now perform the return of life, wind of rest, sky shield, and land of flowers rituals at the fully bloomed everflower.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCredits:
{PAWN_nameDef} completes the coronation. Golden petals settle into a crown above {PAWN_possessive} head.

The great flower's shade, once found only in old fairy tales, has spread again after centuries. The weight of the bond now flows into the bloomed flower as well, and the little lights of a past age have found rest in its embrace. Beneath the warm shade, vivis will live longer lives.

{PAWN_nameDef} has become queen of the vivis.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsNoQueen: The great flower's shade, once found only in old fairy tales, has spread again after centuries. The little lights of a past age have found rest in its embrace, and beneath the warm shade, vivis will live longer lives.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsExiled: The royal vivi who had to leave her home nest because of her small body has raised a fine new nest here.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsRefugee: The refugees who lost their home to the titanic hornets and fled before them now have the strength to defend their own nest.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsOutro: The long season of sleeplessness has passed, and spring has come again to the cold fields. And beneath this flower's shade, your story continues...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureStolen: The everflower on the altar scattered into petals and was drawn into Asphodel. Holding the everflower to herself, the empress vanished again into the darkness beyond the wind of petals.\n\nWith the everflower lost, the final bloom has been interrupted. However, once you prepare an altar and everflower again, you can start the full bloom ritual anew...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureLost: With the altar or everflower lost, the final bloom has been interrupted. However, once you prepare an altar and everflower again, you can start the full bloom ritual anew...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureResonator: {PAWN_labelShort} has fallen, severing the resonance with the everflower. The final bloom has been interrupted.\n\nOnce a new resonator arises, you can start the full bloom ritual anew at the altar.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AncientWitnessLabel: Memory of an old wing, awakened
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AncientWitness:
Having regained a body after long ages, {PAWN_labelShort} gazed up for a while at the golden flower's shade spread overhead. After a steadying breath, {PAWN_labelShort} carefully told of the last day she remembered.

"It was the day the acrid smoke and flames reached into the shade. Lady Asphodel stood alone on the dais. She told us not to cry, that it would not hurt once we became little lights, and she held us close."

"After we became light, it felt as if I was holding her tight in a long, dark dream, listening to crying that never stopped. I wanted to let her go... Now I open my eyes, and she is asleep too, and spring really has come again."

{PAWN_labelShort} quietly bowed her head and said she would live on beneath this flower's shade, found once more.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FederationReaction:
Having seen the wave of full bloom rise from your colony, the vivi federation has sent its congratulations.

The federation never knew the original reason it had sent old fairy tale books to new nests. But seeing the great flower's shade of legend truly bloom again after centuries, they say they were filled with deep awe.

The vivi federation honors the colony led by its new queen and promises lasting friendship.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingApocryphaLanded: Driven back by the everflower's wave, Asphodel has landed at the edge of the map with a swarm of titanic hornets.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingPawnReturned: {PAWN_labelShort} has returned in front of the everflower altar.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingTaleRedelivered: The vivi federation's new copy of {0} has arrived.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDesc: The everflower is condensing mana for its final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_DialogChangeWeatherGoldenBloomDesc: A mist of golden pollen and petals covers the area, preventing fire from spreading, slightly reducing ranged accuracy, and granting unlimited mana to all arcane plants.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GoldenBloomHoldsWeather: The blooming everflower is sustaining the golden mist, preventing weather changes
